articleTitle: Do GLP-1s Affect Weight Loss Beyond Appetite Suppression?
imageHeadline: GLP-1s do more than curb hunger
imageSubtext: How these medications change digestion, cravings, and eating behavior
pinTitle: Do GLP-1s Affect Weight Loss Beyond Appetite Suppression? The Science Explained
pinDescription: GLP-1 medications work through multiple pathways—slowing digestion, shifting food preferences, and reducing cravings for high-fat, high-sugar foods. They don't boost metabolism, but they do make calorie deficits easier to sustain. Here's what the research shows about how these medications actually work.

items.label: Slow gastric emptying keeps you fuller longer
Shift cravings away from high-fat, high-sugar foods
Don't increase metabolism or resting calorie burn
